svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.text: Selected2m axial cable model; not M8 plug
Independent electrical symbol; enlarged, not physical lead order
Host: J37.2 limited5V -> J3.3; J37.3 PB1 INPUT with3V3 pullup -> J3.1; J37.10 GND -> J3.2. Other Prime contacts UNUSED.
Field: isolated24.0V current-limited100mA -> J1.2; isolated0V -> J1.1. Never join fieldGF and hostGND_H.
CR5-AN-1A: BROWN -> J2.2 protectedVF; BLACK NPN output -> J2.3; BLUE -> J2.1 isolatedGF. Three sensor leads all accounted.
SJ1 and SJ2 BOTH1–2: selected Bridged12 source footprints. Verify assembled bridges; do not bridge opposite positions simultaneously.
Primary sensor limits:10–30V, supply10mAmax, output200mAmax, leakage10uAmax, on-drop2Vmax. Named prewired NPN/NO model only.
Expected healthy field: target absent / sensorOFF -> Q1on / SIGLOW; target detected / sensorON -> Q1off / releasedSIGHIGH. NOT guaranteed by this figure.
INCOMPLETE: optocoupler off-current at sensor10uA leakage is not specified by GB CTR bounds tested at5mA. Weak100k gate drive needs matching margin.
No sensor/board combined temperature, fault-state, EMC, installed motion or safety qualification. Use only after the operating-margin gap is resolved.
Field protection is selected TPS26600 plus auxiliary circuit, NOT the root-contract PPTC claim. No board protection rating adopted.
J1/J2 native3.50mm; J3 duplicate2.00/2.54mm; GF1.27mm. Enlarged schematic terminals are not physical mating/cable-orientation evidence.
